notes.title: Bug Fixes, Qol and Fortune Change
notes.content:
Greetings fellow cultivators. Here comes another patch of fixes and changes.

Most of it is bug fixes and some more clarity. There is not a help page on the soul balance conversion in the soul Panel, hopefully this information makes it a bit easier to understand.

The biggest change is Fortune. I have nerfed fortune slightly.
[h3]Old[/h3]
In combat, it used to work as every 100 fortune guaranteed an extra drop, and leftover fortune were rolled as a percentage for an extra roll.

[h3]New[/h3]
Now in combat, fortune is first rolled from 10% to 100% of your fortune value, and then this value is used like before this change. I.e every 100 being a guaranteed extra drop.

If you hate this change let me know, i have felt for a while that fortune was a bit too strong in combat so i wanted to try this. The potential is still same but on average it should give a bit less.

notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here comes another batch of fixes and changes. It is now about a week since release. It has been amazing seeing everyone play and enjoy the game i made. I have read all your feedback and suggestions with great joy. I want to continue to make this game as good as possible for people who enjoy cultivation and idle RPG games like me. 

[h3]Whats next? [/h3]
Currently i have Chinese localization in the works, as soon as it finishes i will add it.
In the discord channel we had a vote on what features and updates people want to see next. Reincarnation system is currently in the lead with sect system in close second, (as of writing this), the poll is still open for a few days. 
So the next goal will be a reincarnation system. 
After that will probably be a type of Sect management system.

Here is the changes for today's update.

[h3]New[/h3]

[list]
[*] Autoplanting feature in the spirit garden. You can now toggle a plant to be continuously replanted and if you want it to fertilize the plot with spirit dew. It will only replant the same type of seed so make sure you have more in your inventory.
[*] Combat calculations have been rewritten. Now combat should feel more consistent. You should miss less due to bad luck.
[/list]
